row.team_price_text: Standard: $34/mo billed annually, flat for 3 users ($40 monthly)
row.evidence: SocialPilot's pricing page says Enterprise 'Includes API Access and Single Sign-On (SSO)' and lists no SCIM or user provisioning on any plan; the help centre has no SSO or SCIM articles.
row.notes: Unchanged status (none), now by absence at medium confidence. Prices changed since June: Essentials is $20/mo monthly or $17/mo billed annually (June row said $30/mo), and Essentials allows only 1 user, so the team plan is now Standard ($34/mo annually, $40 monthly, 3 users, +$5/mo per additional user). Plans are flat per account, so per-user fields are null. Premium $85/mo annually (6 users), Ultimate $170/mo annually (unlimited users), Enterprise Contact Sales. The pricing page does not say whether Enterprise SSO is SAML or OIDC. 'API Access' is an Enterprise feature but no public API reference was found.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Single-user plan, so not the team plan.

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: $34/mo billed annually ($40 billed monthly); 3 users, additional user $5/mo

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.price_text: $170/mo billed annually ($200 billed monthly); unlimited users

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 'API Access' and 'Single Sign-On (SSO)' listed; SSO protocol and API scope not documented. sso/user_api false on lower plans is inferred from these being listed as Enterprise inclusions.

scim.notes: No SCIM on the pricing page, enterprise page, trust centre or help centre (sitemap and search); absence, not an explicit 'no'.

user_api.notes: Enterprise 'API Access' is advertised but no public API reference was found, so user-management coverage is unknown.

limitations.text: Team members are managed manually by the Account Owner or an Admin (roles Admin, Manager, Content Scheduler, Client); deleting a member keeps their queued posts.

fallbacks.notes: docs_public false: no public SSO or API documentation found.
